# optimizelycmssaas_property_format (Data Source)

Looks up a property format. Property formats are read-only in the CMS API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "optimizelycmssaas_property_format" "short_string" {
  key = "shortString"
}

output "data_type" {
  value = data.optimizelycmssaas_property_format.short_string.data_type
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Key of the property format to look up, e.g. shortString.

### Read-Only

- `data_type` (String) Underlying data type, e.g. string, array.
- `display_name` (String) Name of the property format.
- `is_deleted` (Boolean) Whether the property format has been deleted.
- `item_type` (String) Item type when data_type is array.
